title.zh: 卷八 本紀第八: 景宗上
title.raw: 卷八 本紀第八: 景宗上 Volume 8 Annals 8: Jingzong 1

sentences.zh: 景宗上

translations.literal: Jingzong, Part One
translations.idiomatic: Jingzong, Part One

sentences.zh: 景宗孝成康靖皇帝，諱賢，字賢寧，小字明扆。

translations.literal: Emperor Jingzong Xiaocheng Kangjing, taboo name Xian, style name Xianning, childhood name Mingyi.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor Jingzong, posthumous title Xiaocheng Kangjing, personal name Xian, courtesy name Xianning, childhood name Mingyi.

sentences.zh: 世宗皇帝第二子，母曰懷節皇后蕭氏。

translations.literal: Second son of Emperor Shizong; his mother was Empress Huaijie, née Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: He was the second son of Emperor Shizong; his mother was Empress Huaijie of the Xiao clan.

sentences.zh: 察割之亂，帝甫四歲。

translations.literal: At the Chaige Rebellion the Emperor was only four years old.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chaige Rebellion the Emperor was only four years old.

sentences.zh: 穆宗即位，養永興宮。

translations.literal: When Muzong took the throne, he was raised in Yongxing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: After Muzong ascended the throne, he was raised in Yongxing Palace.

sentences.zh: 即長，穆宗酗酒怠政。

translations.literal: Once grown, Muzong drank heavily and neglected governance.
translations.idiomatic: Once he came of age, Muzong drank heavily and neglected governance.

sentences.zh: 帝一日與韓匡嗣語及時事，耶律賢適止之。

translations.literal: One day the Emperor discussed current affairs with Han Kuangsi; Yelü Xianshi stopped it.
translations.idiomatic: One day the Emperor spoke with Han Kuangsi about current affairs, and Yelü Xianshi cut him off.

sentences.zh: 帝悟，不復言。

translations.literal: The Emperor understood and spoke no more.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor took the hint and said no more.

sentences.zh: 應歷十九年春二月戊辰，入見，穆宗曰：「吾兒已成人，可付以政。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Yingli, on wuchen day of the first spring month, he entered for audience; Muzong said, "My son is already grown and may be entrusted with government."
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Yingli, on wuchen day in the first spring month, he came for an audience; Muzong said, "My son is already grown and may be entrusted with government."

sentences.zh: 」己巳，穆宗遇弒，帝率飛龍使女裏、侍中蕭思溫、南院樞密使高勛率甲騎千人馳赴。

translations.literal: On jisi day Muzong was assassinated; the Emperor led Flying Dragon Commissioner Nüli, Palace Attendant Xiao Siwen, and Southern Chancellery Commissioner Gao Xun with a thousand armored horsemen in haste to the spot.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Muzong was assassinated; the Emperor led Flying Dragon Commissioner Nüli, Palace Attendant Xiao Siwen, and Southern Chancellery Commissioner Gao Xun at the head of a thousand armored horsemen in haste to the scene.

sentences.zh: 黎明，至行在，哭之慟。

translations.literal: At dawn he reached the traveling palace and wept bitterly.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn he reached the traveling palace and wept in deep grief.

sentences.zh: 群臣勸進，遂即皇帝位於柩前。

translations.literal: The ministers urged him to take the throne, and he thereupon ascended the imperial seat before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers urged him to ascend, and he took the throne before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 百官上尊號曰天贊皇帝，大赦，改元保寧。

translations.literal: The officials submitted the honorific title Emperor Tianzan, granted a grand amnesty, and changed the era name to Baoning.
translations.idiomatic: The officials submitted the honorific title Emperor Tianzan; a grand amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Baoning.

sentences.zh: 以殿前都點檢耶律夷臘、右皮室詳穩蕭烏裏只宿衛不嚴，斬之。

translations.literal: Because Palace Front Inspector Yelü Yila and right Pishi xiangwen Xiao Wulizhi had failed to guard the palace strictly, both were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Front Inspector Yelü Yila and right Pishi xiangwen Xiao Wulizhi were beheaded for lax palace security.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，入上京，以蕭思溫為北院樞密使。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingxu day, he entered the Supreme Capital and made Xiao Siwen Northern Chancellery Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingxu day, he entered the Supreme Capital and appointed Xiao Siwen Northern Chancellery Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 太平王罨撒葛亡入沙沱。

translations.literal: Prince of Taiping Yansage fled into Shato.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Taiping Yansage fled into Shato.

sentences.zh: 己丑，夷離畢粘木袞以陰附罨撒葛伏誅。

translations.literal: On jichou day yilijin Nianmugun, who had secretly joined Yansage, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day yilijin Nianmugun was put to death for secretly siding with Yansage.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，罨撒葛入朝。

translations.literal: On guisi day Yansage entered court.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Yansage came to court and submitted.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以北院樞密使蕭思溫兼北府宰相。

translations.literal: On jiawu day Northern Chancellery Commissioner Xiao Siwen was additionally made Northern Prime Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Northern Chancellery Commissioner Xiao Siwen was also made Northern Prime Minister.

sentences.zh: 己亥，南院樞密使高勛封秦王。

translations.literal: On jihai day Southern Chancellery Commissioner Gao Xun was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Southern Chancellery Commissioner Gao Xun was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申朔，進封太平王罨撒葛為齊王，改封趙王喜隱為宋王，封隆先為平王，稍為吳王，道隱為蜀王，必攝為越王，敵烈為冀王，宛為衛王。

translations.literal: That summer, on the wushen new moon of the fourth month, Prince of Taiping Yansage was advanced to Prince of Qi; Prince of Zhao Xiyin was changed to Prince of Song; Longxian was enfeoffed as Prince of Ping, Shao as Prince of Wu, Daoyin as Prince of Shu, Bishe as Prince of Yue, Dilie as Prince of Ji, and Wan as Prince of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, on the wushen new moon of the fourth month, Prince of Taiping Yansage was advanced to Prince of Qi; Prince of Zhao Xiyin was renamed Prince of Song; Longxian was made Prince of Ping, Shao Prince of Wu, Daoyin Prince of Shu, Bishe Prince of Yue, Dilie Prince of Ji, and Wan Prince of Wei.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，立貴妃蕭氏為皇后。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on wuyin day, Consort Xiao was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuyin day, Consort Xiao of the Xiao clan was made empress.

sentences.zh: 丙申，射柳祈雨。

translations.literal: On bingshen day he shot the willow branch to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Emperor shot the willow branch to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 有司請以帝生日為天清節，從之。

translations.literal: The officials requested that the Emperor's birthday be made the Tianqing Festival, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The officials asked that the Emperor's birthday be declared the Tianqing Festival, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，漢遣李匡弼、劉繼文、李元素等來賀。

translations.literal: On renyin day Han sent Li Kuangbi, Liu Jiwen, Li Yuansu, and others to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Han sent Li Kuangbi, Liu Jiwen, Li Yuansu, and others to offer congratulations on the accession.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，東幸瑽潭。

translations.literal: That winter, in the tenth month, he traveled east to Congtan.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, the Emperor traveled east to Congtan.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰朔，行柴冊禮，祠木葉山，駐蹕鶴谷。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the jiachen new moon, he performed the fire-wood enthronement rite, sacrificed to Mount Muye, and halted at Crane Valley.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiachen new moon, he performed the fire-wood enthronement rite, sacrificed to Mount Muye, and encamped at Crane Valley.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，蕭思溫封魏王，北院大王屋質加於越。

translations.literal: On yisi day Xiao Siwen was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei, and Northern Grand Prince Wuzhi was advanced to yuyue.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Xiao Siwen was enfeoffed as Prince of Wei, and Northern Grand Prince Wuzhi was promoted to yuyue.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁未，如潢河。

translations.literal: In the second year, on dingwei day of the first spring month, he went to the Huang River.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on dingwei day in the first spring month, the Emperor went to the Huang River.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，幸東京，致奠於讓國皇帝及世宗廟。

translations.literal: That summer, in the fourth month, he visited the Eastern Capital and offered sacrifice at the temples of the Abdication Emperor and Shizong.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, he visited the Eastern Capital and made offerings at the temples of the Abdication Emperor and Shizong.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，西幸。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on guichou day, he traveled west.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guichou day, the Emperor traveled west.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，次盤道嶺，盜殺北院樞密使蕭思溫。

translations.literal: On yimao day he halted at Pansdao Ridge; bandits murdered Northern Chancellery Commissioner Xiao Siwen.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the court halted at Pansdao Ridge, where bandits murdered Northern Chancellery Commissioner Xiao Siwen.

sentences.zh: 六月，還上京。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he returned to the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Emperor returned to the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，以右皮室詳穩賢適為北院樞密使。

translations.literal: That autumn, in the seventh month, right Pishi xiangwen Xianshi was made Northern Chancellery Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month, right Pishi xiangwen Xianshi was appointed Northern Chancellery Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，得國舅蕭海只及海裏殺蕭思溫狀，皆伏誅，流其弟神睹於黃龍府。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on xinchou day, evidence was obtained that the empress's uncle Xiao Haizhi and Haili had killed Xiao Siwen; both were executed, and Siwen's brother Shendu was exiled to Huanglong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinchou day, proof was obtained that the empress's uncle Xiao Haizhi and Haili had murdered Xiao Siwen; both were put to death, and Siwen's brother Shendu was banished to Huanglong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月庚午，漢遣使來貢。

translations.literal: That winter, in the twelfth month on gengwu day, Han sent tribute envoys.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the twelfth month on gengwu day, Han sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月甲寅，右夷離畢奚底遣人獻敵烈俘，詔賜有功將士。

translations.literal: In the third year, on jiayin day of the first spring month, right yilijin Xidi sent men presenting captives of Dilie; an edict granted rewards to meritorious officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on jiayin day in the first spring month, right yilijin Xidi sent men with captives taken from Dilie; an edict rewarded the officers and soldiers who had earned merit.

sentences.zh: 庚申，置登聞鼓院。

translations.literal: On gengshen day the Petition Drum Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Petition Drum Office was established.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，南京統軍使魏國公韓匡美封鄴王。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Southern Capital Military Commissioner Duke of Wei Han Kuangmei was enfeoffed as Prince of Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Southern Capital Military Commissioner Han Kuangmei, Duke of Wei, was enfeoffed as Prince of Ye.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，東幸。

translations.literal: In the second month, on guiyou day, he traveled east.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guiyou day, the Emperor traveled east.

sentences.zh: 壬午，遣鐸遏使阿薩蘭回鶻。

translations.literal: On renwu day the duo'e commissioner was sent to Uighur.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day a duo'e commissioner was dispatched to the Uighurs.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以青牛白馬祭天地。

translations.literal: On jichou day a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the Emperor sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，以飛龍使女裏為契丹行宮都部署。

translations.literal: In the third month, on dingwei day, Flying Dragon Commissioner Nüli was made Khitan traveling palace chief steward.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingwei day, Flying Dragon Commissioner Nüli was appointed chief steward of the Khitan traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，世宗妃啜裏及蒲哥厭魅，賜死。

translations.literal: That summer, in the fourth month on dingmao day, Shizong's consorts Chuoluo and Puge used malevolent sorcery and were granted death.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month on dingmao day, Shizong's consorts Chuoluo and Puge were executed for sorcery.

sentences.zh: 己卯，祠木葉山，行再生禮。

translations.literal: On jimao day he sacrificed to Mount Muye and performed the rebirth rite.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the Emperor sacrificed to Mount Muye and performed the rebirth rite.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，至自東幸。

translations.literal: On bingxu day he returned from the eastern tour.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Emperor returned from the eastern tour.

sentences.zh: 戊子，蕭神睹伏誅。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Xiao Shendu was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Xiao Shendu was put to death.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，漢遣使問起居，自是繼月而至。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on bingzi day, Han sent envoys inquiring after the Emperor's health; from then on they came month after month.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingzi day, Han sent envoys to inquire after the Emperor's health, and such missions thereafter arrived every month.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，回鶻遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Uighur sent tribute envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Uighurs sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，以北院樞密使賢適為西北路招討使。

translations.literal: That autumn, in the seventh month on xinchou day, Northern Chancellery Commissioner Xianshi was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month on xinchou day, Northern Chancellery Commissioner Xianshi was appointed Northwest Route pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，如秋山。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiaxu day, he went to Autumn Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiaxu day, the Emperor went to Autumn Mountain.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，祭皇兄吼墓，追冊為皇太子，謚莊聖。

translations.literal: On xinmao day he sacrificed at the tomb of his elder brother Hou; Hou was posthumously enfeoffed as crown prince with posthumous title Zhuangsheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Emperor sacrificed at the tomb of his elder brother Hou, who was posthumously enfeoffed as crown prince with the posthumous title Zhuangsheng.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，賜傅父侍中達裏叠、太保楚補、太保婆兒、保母回室、押雅等戶口、牛羊有差。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yisi day, wet-nurse fathers Palace Attendant Daliedie, Grand Guardian Chubu, Grand Guardian Po'er, nurse Huishi, yaya, and others were granted households and cattle and sheep in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yisi day, the wet-nurse fathers Palace Attendant Daliedie, Grand Guardian Chubu, Grand Guardian Po'er, nurse Huishi, yaya, and others received grants of households, cattle, and sheep according to rank.

sentences.zh: 又以潛邸給使者為撻馬部，置官掌之。

translations.literal: The former residence's supply envoys were also made the tame-horse section, with officials appointed to administer it.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from the former princely residence were also organized as the tame-horse section, with officials appointed to oversee it.

sentences.zh: 壬子，幸歸化州。

translations.literal: On renzi day he visited Guihua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the Emperor visited Guihua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，如南京。

translations.literal: On jiayin day he went to the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Emperor went to the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己巳，以黑白羊祀神。

translations.literal: That winter, in the tenth month on jisi day, black and white sheep were sacrificed to the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month on jisi day, black and white sheep were sacrificed to the spirits.

sentences.zh: 癸未，漢遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On guiwei day Han sent tribute envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Han sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，鼻骨德、吐谷渾來貢。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Biegude and Tuyuhun came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Biegude and Tuyuhun sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚子，臚朐河於越延尼裏等率戶四百五十來附，乞隸宮籍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengzi day, yuyue Yan Nili of Luchu River and others led four hundred fifty households to submit and asked to be enrolled in palace registers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengzi day, yuyue Yan Nili of Luchu River and others led four hundred fifty households to submit and petitioned to be enrolled in palace registers.

sentences.zh: 詔留其戶，分隸敦睦、積慶、永興三宮，優賜遣之。

translations.literal: An edict retained their households and distributed them among the Dunmu, Jiqing, and Yongxing palaces; they were generously rewarded and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: An edict kept their households and assigned them to the Dunmu, Jiqing, and Yongxing palaces; they were richly rewarded and sent home.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，以青牛白馬祭天地。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guiyou day, a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guiyou day, the Emperor sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 己丑，皇子隆緒生。

translations.literal: On jichou day Prince Longxu was born.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Prince Longxu was born.

sentences.zh: 是冬，駐蹕金川。

translations.literal: That winter the court encamped at Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月甲子，惕隱休哥伐党項，破之，以俘獲之數來上。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, on jiazi day of the first spring month, tithen Xiuge attacked the Tangut and defeated them, presenting the tally of captives.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on jiazi day in the first spring month, tithen Xiuge attacked the Tangut, routed them, and reported the number of captives taken.

sentences.zh: 漢遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Han sent tribute envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Han sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 庚午，禦五鳳樓觀燈。

translations.literal: On gengwu day he mounted the Five Phoenix Tower to view the lanterns.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Emperor mounted the Five Phoenix Tower to view the lanterns.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，近侍實魯裏誤觸神纛，法論死，杖釋之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dinghai day, the attendant Shiluli accidentally touched the spirit banner; by law he deserved death, but he was beaten and released.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dinghai day, the attendant Shiluli accidentally touched the spirit banner; though the law called for death, he was caned and released.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，越王必攝獻党項俘獲之數。

translations.literal: On renchen day Prince of Yue Bishe presented the tally of Tangut captives.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Prince of Yue Bishe presented the count of Tangut captives taken.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以青牛白馬祭天地。

translations.literal: On wushen day a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the Emperor sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，幸新城。

translations.literal: On xinhai day he visited New City.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Emperor visited New City.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯朔，復幸新城。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the yimao new moon, he again visited New City.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao new moon of the third month the Emperor again visited New City.

sentences.zh: 追封皇后祖胡母裏為韓王，贈伯胡魯古兼政事令，尼古只兼侍中。

translations.literal: The empress's grandfather Humuli was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Han; bos Huolugu was granted concurrent Chief Councillor, and Niguzhi concurrent Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: The empress's grandfather Humuli was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Han; bos Huolugu was granted the concurrent title Chief Councillor, and Niguzhi concurrent Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申，白氣晝見。

translations.literal: That summer, in the fourth month on bingshen day, a white vapor was seen by day.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month on bingshen day, a white vapor appeared in the daytime sky.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，於越屋質薨，輟朝三日。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on guihai day, yuyue Wuzhi died; court was suspended for three days.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guihai day, yuyue Wuzhi died; court was suspended for three days.

sentences.zh: 辛未，女直侵邊，殺都監達裏叠、拽剌斡裏魯，驅掠邊民牛馬。

translations.literal: On xinwei day the Jurchen raided the border, killing supervisors Daliedie and Zhuaolawuilu and driving off the border people's cattle and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Jurchen raided the frontier, killing supervisors Daliedie and Zhuaolawuilu and seizing cattle and horses from the border population.

sentences.zh: 己卯，阿薩蘭回鶻來貢。

translations.literal: On jimao day Asalan Uighur came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the Asalan Uighurs sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅，女直宰相及夷離堇來朝。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengyin day, Jurchen chancellor and yilijin came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengyin day, the Jurchen chancellor and yilijin came to court.

sentences.zh: 丙申，漢遣人以宋事來告。

translations.literal: On bingshen day Han sent men to report on Song affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Han sent envoys to report on affairs with Song.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰，以保大軍節度使耶律斜裏底為中臺省左相。

translations.literal: That autumn, in the seventh month on gengchen day, Baoda Army Military Commissioner Yelü Xielidi was made Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month on gengchen day, Baoda Army Military Commissioner Yelü Xielidi was appointed Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 是月，駐蹕燕子城。

translations.literal: That month the court encamped at Swallow City.
translations.idiomatic: That month the court encamped at Swallow City.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，鼻骨德部長曷魯撻覽來貢。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renzi day, Biegude tribal chief Helutalan came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renzi day, Biegude tribal chief Helutalan sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉，如南京。

translations.literal: That winter, in the tenth month on dingyou day, he went to the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month on dingyou day, the Emperor went to the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥朔，始獲應歷逆黨近侍小哥、花哥、辛古等，誅之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the xinhai new moon, Yingli rebels the attendant Xiaoge, Huage, Xingu, and others were at last captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the xinhai new moon, Xiaoge, Huage, Xingu, and other Yingli-era rebels among the attendants were at last captured and put to death.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，漢將改元，遣使稟命。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuxu day, Han was about to change its era name and sent envoys to report for imperial approval.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuxu day, Han planned to change its era name and sent envoys to seek imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 是月，如歸化州。

translations.literal: That month he went to Guihua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Emperor went to Guihua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 鵩六年春正月癸未，幸南京。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, on guiwei day of the first spring month, he visited the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, on guiwei day in the first spring month, the Emperor visited the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 三月，宋遣使請和，以涿州刺史耶律昌朮加侍中與宋議和。

translations.literal: In the third month Song sent envoys requesting peace; Youzhou Prefecture prefect Yelü Changzhu was additionally made Palace Attendant to negotiate peace with Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Song sent envoys seeking peace; Youzhou Prefecture prefect Yelü Changzhu was also made Palace Attendant to negotiate terms with Song.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，宋王喜隱坐謀反廢。

translations.literal: That summer, in the fourth month, Prince of Song Xiyin was deposed for plotting rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, Prince of Song Xiyin was deposed for plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁未朔，閤門使酌古加檢校太尉兼御史大夫，男海裏以告喜隱事，遙授隴州防禦使。

translations.literal: That autumn, on the dingwei new moon of the seventh month, Gate Commissioner Zhuogu was additionally made honorary Grand Marshal and Censor-in-Chief; his son Haili, who had reported Xiyin's plot, was remotely appointed Defense Commissioner of Long Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, on the dingwei new moon of the seventh month, Gate Commissioner Zhuogu was also made honorary Grand Marshal and Censor-in-Chief; his son Haili, who had reported Xiyin's conspiracy, was remotely appointed Defense Commissioner of Long Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚申，獵於平地松林。

translations.literal: On gengshen day he hunted at Level Ground Pine Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Emperor hunted at Level Ground Pine Forest.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙亥朔，還上京。

translations.literal: That winter, on the yihai new moon of the tenth month, he returned to the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, on the yihai new moon of the tenth month, the Emperor returned to the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，以沙門照敏為三京諸道僧尼都總管，加兼侍中。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuzi day, the monk Zhaomin was made chief overseer of monks and nuns throughout the Three Capitals and all circuits, additionally made Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuzi day, the monk Zhaomin was appointed chief overseer of monks and nuns in the Three Capitals and all circuits and was also made Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月甲戌朔，宋遣使來賀。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, on the jiaxu new moon of the first spring month, Song sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on the jiaxu new moon of the first spring month, Song sent envoys to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，望祠木葉山。

translations.literal: On renyin day he performed the full-moon sacrifice at Mount Muye.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the Emperor performed the full-moon sacrifice at Mount Muye.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，漢雁門節度使劉繼文來朝。

translations.literal: In the second month, on guihai day, Han's Yanmen Military Commissioner Liu Jiwen came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guihai day, Han's Yanmen Military Commissioner Liu Jiwen came to court.

sentences.zh: 貢方物。

translations.literal: He presented local products as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: He presented local products in tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以青牛白馬祭天地。

translations.literal: On bingyin day a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Emperor sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，耶律速撒等獻党項俘，分賜群臣。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renwu day, Yelü Susa and others presented Tangut captives, which were distributed as gifts among the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renwu day, Yelü Susa and others presented Tangut captives, which were distributed among the ministers.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，遣郎君矧思使宋。

translations.literal: That summer, in the fourth month, langjun Shansi was sent as envoy to Song.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, langjun Shansi was dispatched as envoy to Song.

sentences.zh: 己酉，祠木葉山。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, sacrificed at Mount Muye.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day he offered sacrifice at Mount Muye.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，射柳祈雨。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, shot willow to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day he performed the willow-shooting rite to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 如頻蹕澱清暑。

translations.literal: He went to Pinbi Marsh to escape the summer heat.
translations.idiomatic: He went to Pinbi Marsh for his summer quarters.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，祭神姑。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingxu day, sacrificed to the divine aunt.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day in the fifth month he sacrificed to the divine aunt.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，黃龍府衛將燕頗殺都監張琚以叛，遣敞史耶律曷裏必討之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Huanglong Prefecture garrison officer Yan Yan killed superintendent Zhang Ju in rebellion; commissary Yelü Helibi was dispatched to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Huanglong Prefecture garrison officer Yan Yan killed superintendent Zhang Ju and rebelled; commissary Yelü Helibi was sent to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 九月，敗燕頗於治河，遣其弟安摶追之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Yan Yan was defeated at the Zhi River; his brother Anbo was sent in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Yan Yan was defeated at the Zhi River and his brother Anbo was dispatched in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 燕頗走保兀惹城，安摶乃還，以餘黨千餘戶城通州。

translations.literal: Yan Yan fled and held Wurena city; Anbo then returned, and over a thousand households of the remnant force were walled at Tong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Yan fled and held Wurena city; Anbo then withdrew, and more than a thousand households of the remnant force were settled behind walls at Tong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是秋，至自頻蹕澱。

translations.literal: That autumn, returned from Pinbi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he returned from Pinbi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，鉤魚土河。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, ice-fished on the Tu River.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month he ice-fished on the Tu River.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月癸酉，宋遣使來聘。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, on guiyou day in the first month of spring, Song sent envoys on a visit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on guiyou day in the first spring month, Song sent envoys on a diplomatic visit.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，諭史館學士，書皇后言亦稱「朕」暨「予」，著為定式。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renyin day, instructed Hanlin academicians that in writing the empress's words also use "I" (zhen and yu), establishing this as fixed form.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day in the second month he instructed the Hanlin academicians that in official records the empress's pronouncements were also to use "I" — both zhen and yu — and this was established as fixed convention.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，遣五使廉問四方鰥寡孤獨及貧乏失職者，振之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinwei day, dispatched five envoys to inquire throughout the four directions after widowers, widows, orphans, the solitary, and those impoverished who had lost office, and relieved them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day in the third month he dispatched five envoys to inquire throughout the realm after widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary, as well as the poor who had lost their positions, and granted them relief.

sentences.zh: 夏六月，以西南面招討使耶律斜軫為北院大王。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer, Southwest circuit pacification commissioner Yelü Xiezhen was made Northern Court Great King.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth summer month Southwest circuit pacification commissioner Yelü Xiezhen was appointed Northern Court Great King.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙寅朔，寧王只沒妻安只伏誅，只沒、高勛等除名。

translations.literal: On the first day of the seventh month of autumn, bingyin day, Prince of Ning Zhimel's wife Anzhi was executed; Zhimel, Gao Xun, and others were struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, the first of the seventh autumn month, Prince of Ning Zhimel's wife Anzhi was executed and Zhimel, Gao Xun, and others were removed from office.

sentences.zh: 辛未，宋遣使來賀天清節。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Song sent envoys to congratulate the Tianqing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Song sent envoys to offer congratulations on the Tianqing Festival.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，漢遣使言天清節設無遮會，飯僧祝釐。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on guimao day, Han sent envoys saying that for the Tianqing Festival they held an unbounded assembly, fed monks, and prayed for blessings.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day in the eighth month Han sent envoys reporting that for the Tianqing Festival they had held an unbounded assembly, fed the monks, and prayed for blessings.

sentences.zh: 丁未，如秋山。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, went to Autumn Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day he went to Autumn Mountain.

sentences.zh: 己酉，漢以宋事來告。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Han came reporting Song affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Han sent word reporting developments in Song affairs.

sentences.zh: 是月，女直侵貴德州東境。

translations.literal: That month, Jurchen invaded the eastern border of Guide Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jurchen raided the eastern border of Guide Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，謁懷陵。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jisi day, visited Huai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day in the ninth month he visited Huai Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 辛未，東京統軍使察鄰、詳穩涸奏女直襲歸州五寨，剽掠而去。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Eastern Capital garrison commander Chalin and xiangwen He reported Jurchen attacked five stockades of Gui Prefecture and raided away.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Eastern Capital garrison commander Chalin and xiangwen He reported that Jurchen had struck five stockades in Gui Prefecture and withdrawn after plundering.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，鼻骨德來貢。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Biegude came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the Biegude brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬午，漢為宋人所侵，遣使求援，命南府宰相耶律沙、冀王敵烈赴之。

translations.literal: On renwu day, Han being invaded by Song sent envoys seeking aid; Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha and Prince of Ji Delie were ordered to go.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Han, under attack by Song, sent envoys begging aid; Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha and Prince of Ji Delie were ordered to march to their relief.

sentences.zh: 戊子，漢以宋師壓境，遣駙馬都尉盧俊來告。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Han reported Song army pressing the border; imperial son-in-law commander Lu Jun was sent to inform.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Han reported that Song troops were pressing the frontier and sent imperial son-in-law commander Lu Jun to notify the court.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛丑，漢以遼師退宋軍來謝。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinchou day, Han came to thank because Liao army drove back Song army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the tenth winter month Han sent envoys to thank the court after Liao troops had driven back the Song army.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，宋主匡胤殂，其弟炅自立，遣使來告。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingzi day, Song ruler Zhao Kuangyin died; his brother Zhao Kuangyi seized the throne and sent envoys to announce.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day in the eleventh month Song ruler Zhao Kuangyin died; his brother Zhao Kuangyi took the throne himself and sent envoys to announce the fact.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，遣郎君王六、撻馬涅木古等使宋吊慰。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, dispatched langjun Wang Liu, tamasa Niemugu, and others as envoys to Song for condolences.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day langjun Wang Liu, tamasa Niemugu, and others were dispatched to Song to offer mourning condolences.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，遣蕭只古、馬哲賀宋即位。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on renyin day, dispatched Xiao Zhigu and Ma Zhe to congratulate Song on accession.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day in the twelfth month Xiao Zhigu and Ma Zhe were sent to congratulate Song on the new ruler's accession.

sentences.zh: 丁未，漢以宋軍復至掠其軍儲來告。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, Han reported Song army again arrived and plundered their military stores.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Han reported that Song troops had again crossed the border and stripped their military stores.

sentences.zh: 且乞賜糧為助。

translations.literal: And requested grain as aid.
translations.idiomatic: They also begged grain as assistance.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔南京復禮部貢院。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, edict restored Ministry of Rites examination hall at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict ordered the restoration of the Ministry of Rites examination hall at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 是月，轄戛斯國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: That month, Kirghiz sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That month envoys from Kirghiz arrived with tribute.
